description: List the survey tests that are holding a number now, plus `numbers`: how many survey numbers the workspace owns and how many are busy and free. Each run has a runId, configId, agentE164 (the nopaque number the survey should be sent to), endUserE164 (the number the survey should come from), state (waiting, in_progress, complete or timed_out), live, channel (sms_chat or phone_call, once the survey arrives), expectedTurns, answersGiven, startedAt, engagedAt and expiresAt (epoch seconds). Takes no parameters. Use when: the user asks whether a survey test is waiting or under way, or why a new one cannot start (each test occupies one number for its whole window, so no free numbers means it is refused). Finished tests drop off this list: for what happened in them use listSurveyResults. Read-only. Needs testing:read.
name: listSurveyRuns

numbers.description:
Concurrency, made visible. A run occupies a number for its window,
so this is what to check before starting another test.

total.description: Live survey numbers this workspace owns.

items.description:
A survey test — nopaque waiting to answer one survey it did not initiate.

A test occupies one of your numbers, paired with the sender it expects.
That pair is the only identity an inbound call or SMS carries, so while
a test is live no other test may use the same pair — which is why
running more at once means owning more numbers.

agentE164.description: The nopaque number this run answers on — point the survey here.

answersGiven.description: How many times the respondent has answered so far.

channel.description: Observed when the conversation starts; absent until then.

endUserE164.description: The number the survey is expected to originate from.

enforcementActive.description:
Whether anything can stop the respondent talking.

`false` means no question count is set, so it answers whatever it
is sent until you stop the test or the window closes. That is a
legitimate way to run a test — but it is reported rather than left
to be inferred, because a test that cannot be stopped otherwise
looks exactly like one that can.

engagedAt.description: When a conversation actually started, if one has.

expectedTurns.description:
The question count in force for this test — taken from the
respondent unless the start call overrode it. Absent means none is
set.

expiresAt.description:
Epoch SECONDS. The row may outlive this value — expiry sweeps are
lazy — so judge liveness by `live`, not by the row existing.

title: List Live Survey Tests
